entry.name: abl.device.echo~
entry.description: A modulation delay effect that allows setting the delay time on two independent delay lines, while also giving control over envelope and filter modulation.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: channel_mode
attributes.description: Sets the channel mode.

attributes.name: clip
attributes.description: Applies the input gain to the dry signal as well, allowing distortion for an authentic hardware feel.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: drywetmode
attributes.description: Sets the way processed and dry signals are balanced.

choices.label: Makes a 50/50 mix to sound equally loud for most signals

attributes.name: duck
attributes.description: When enabled, the wet signal will be proportionally reduced as long as there is an input signal.

attributes.name: duck_release
attributes.description: Sets the ducking release time in seconds. [0.02, 1.5]

attributes.name: duck_threshold
attributes.description: Sets the ducking threshold in dB. [-60., 0.]

attributes.name: fbinvert
attributes.description: Enables/disables inverting the feedback signal before adding it back to the input. This can change the sound significantly for short delay times.

attributes.name: feedback
attributes.description: Sets the amount of each channel's output that is fed back into its input. [0., 1.5]

attributes.name: gate_threshold
attributes.description: Sets the gate threshold in dB. [-60., 0.]

attributes.description: Sets the input gain in dB. [-40., 40.]

attributes.name: ins
attributes.description: Declares additional inlets that can be used to control float-type attributes at either event or signal rate. Any declared attributes already mapped to inlets will be ignored. This attribute can only be set when the object is instantiated.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: mix
attributes.description: Sets the dry/wet mix of the output signal.

attributes.name: mod_delay
attributes.description: Adjust the amount of modulation that is applied to the delay time. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: mod_envelope
attributes.description: Blend between the modulation oscillator and an envelope follower. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: mod_freq
attributes.description: Sets the frequency of the modulation oscillator in Hz. [0.01, 40.]

attributes.name: mod_mult
attributes.description: Enables/disables scaling the delay time modulation depth by a factor of four. With short delay times, this produces deep flanging sounds.

attributes.name: mod_phase
attributes.description: Adjusts the amount of offset between the waveforms for the left and right channel. At 180 degrees, the channels will be perfectly out of phase. [0., 180.]

attributes.name: mod_waveform
attributes.description: Sets the modulation waveform.

attributes.name: noise
attributes.description: Sets the amount of noise added to the signal. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: noise_morph
attributes.description: Morph between different types of noise. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: output
attributes.description: Sets the output gain in dB. [-76., 12.]

attributes.name: repitch
attributes.description: This causes a pitch variation when changing the delay time, similar to the behavior of hardware delay units. When disabled, changing the delay time creates a crossfade between the new and old delay times.

attributes.name: repitch_smoothing_time
attributes.description: Adjust how quickly a new pitch variation is applied when changing the delay time. [0.01, 1.]

attributes.name: reverb
attributes.description: Sets the amount of reverb. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: reverb_decay
attributes.description: Sets the length of the reverb tail. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: reverb_location
attributes.description: Sets the location in the processing chain where reverb is added.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Sets the stereo width of the wet signal. 0 yields a mono signal whereas values from 1 to 2 create a widened stereo panorama. [0., 2.]

attributes.name: wobble
attributes.description: Sets the amount of wobble added to the signal. This adds irregular modulation of the delay time, simulating tape delays. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: wobble_morph
attributes.description: Morph between different types of wobble modulation. [0., 1.]
